quests.instruction: Complete the sentence with the best connector.
quests.question: Elena arrived an hour early ____ she could set up the projector before everyone arrived.
quests.sentence: Elena arrived an hour early ____ she could set up the projector before everyone arrived.
quests.hint: This describes her intention or goal in coming early - not simply a result that happened afterward.
quests.explanation: 'So that' introduces the purpose behind her early arrival - setting up the projector was her goal. 'So' alone would instead describe an unplanned result, not a deliberate purpose.
